t: You're standing at the East Tunnel at London Zoo, in the City of Westminster. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects and landscapers of the nineteenth century. He's the same man who became architect to the Royal Botanic Society in 1840, so his skills covered both buildings and landscapes. That mix of the two suits a zoo, where structures and planted ground have to work together. It's a small piece of a much larger site.
